Class RunTicketMiner

java.lang.Object
ticketminer.RunTicketMiner
public class RunTicketMiner extends Object
Main driver class for the TicketMiner system. This class starts the application, loads CSV data, and provides menu navigation for users to manage venues, events, and accounts.
